Untitled/BaD-mindset-journal/BaD-Mindd-s.title: BaD Mindd set Journal
Untitled/BaD-mindset-journal/BaD-Mindd-s.content:
Choice is actively taking part in life or living deliberately, Always thinking ahead and making a plan. Laughing in the face of Adversity and taking the risk, going to hell with it and saying my dream will come true because I will make it a reality.
I would rate my ability with this mind set like a 7 since I know I have the ability to choose but I have issues enacting my choices or actively being present in my life. So I Need to follow what I want to do and ignore my doubts and actively work towards my  goals.
I intend to get better at following what I want to do instead of just what is expected of me. I also want to get better at responding instead of reacting since I tend to just react and it tends to not benefit me and just hinder me.
A good example of me actively choosing and making a decision and working towards my main goal is when I decided that I would no longer take French so I could take 2 art classes. I did this so I could more easily create a portfolio for applying to collages and art school. I did this so I could have more time to do art since I have a very tight schedule.
